task: Spoken order from the warehouse operator: "Swap the banana and the pear.". This is a NEW job that the team has no ready-made skill for. Plan it yourself from the robot actions: find the items (drone_scan, recall), carry them one at a time (go_to, pick, then place_on('tray') or put_aside() on a station's table), and check every result. Do exactly what the operator asked; leave other items where they are. Afterwards an independent judge compares where every item was before and after. The drone can scout the stations; the ground robot carries one item at a time. Wind may be blowing.
lesson: To swap two items while carrying only one at a time, temporarily stage the first item with put_aside on the second item's table to free the gripper, then ferry the second item back.

task: Spoken order from the warehouse operator: "Swap the banana and the pear and then land the drone on the robot.". This is a NEW job that the team has no ready-made skill for. Plan it yourself from the robot actions: find the items (drone_scan, recall; if the drone misses an item, visit the tables and use sees), carry them one at a time (go_to, pick, then place_on('tray') or put_aside() on a station's table), and check every result. If the order also asks to land the drone on the moving robot, call land_on_moving_robot() at the end. Do exactly what the operator asked; leave other items where they are. Where the items start: gelatin box: on the table of station A; strawberry: on the table of station A; banana: on the table of station B; scissors: on the table of station B; pear: on the table of station C; medium clamp: on the table of station C; soup can: on the table of station C. Afterwards an independent judge compares where every item was before and after. The drone can scout the stations; the ground robot carries one item at a time. Wind may be blowing.
lesson: To swap two items then land the drone, stage the first item with put_aside on the second item's table to free the gripper, ferry the second item back, then call land_on_moving_robot() at the end.
